data.name: Asman
data.gender_notes: Asman is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘samaa’ meaning ‘sky’ or ‘heaven’. In Islamic tradition, it can symbolize a connection to the divine. The name Asman carries the meaning “Sky, Heaven” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asman usually hope their child will grow to embody sky, heaven and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes the divine and spiritual nature of a person. It is a reminder of the connection between the human soul and the divine creator.
data.etymology: Asman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sky, Heaven.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asman total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: أَسْمَان
in_arabic.meaning: السماء السماء السقف السطحي للكرة الأرضية
in_arabic.long_meaning: أَسْمَان: اسم علم من أصول عربية، يُنظر إليه على أنه اسم للهندسة السماوية، ويُعتبر من أسماء الله الحسنى في القرآن الكريم. يعني اسم أَسْمَان السماء الكبيرة، ويُستخدم في القرآن لوصف خلق الله للسماء والأرض. يُعتبر اسم أَسْمَان اسمًا شائعًا في الثقافة العربية الإسلامية، ويُستخدم لتعزيز الإيمان بالله وعبده.

in_urdu.name: اسمان
in_urdu.meaning: آسمان آسمانی کا سقف اور سطہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسمان: ایک مسلمان خاندان میں ایک لڑکا یا لڑکی کا نام۔ اس کا مطلب ہے آسمان اور اس کا سقف۔ یہ نام اللہ تعالیٰ کے اسماء الحسنہ میں سے ایک ہے۔ یہ نام قرآن کریم میں بھی آتا ہے جہاں اللہ تعالیٰ نے آسمان اور زمین کی تخلیق کا ذکر کیا ہے۔ اس نام کو مسلمانوں میں بہت شائق کیا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ نام اللہ تعالیٰ کے عظمت اور قدرت کا اظہار ہے۔

in_hindi.name: असमान
in_hindi.long_meaning: असमान: एक हिंदू-मुस्लिम परिवार में एक लड़के या लड़की का नाम। इसका अर्थ है आसमान और इसका स्तंभ। यह नाम अल्लाह के नामों में से एक है जो कुरान में भी आता है जहाँ अल्लाह ने आसमान और धरती की रचना का ज़िक्र किया है। इस नाम को हिंदू-मुस्लिम पारिवारिक संस्कृति में बहुत प्यार किया जाता है क्योंकि यह अल्लाह की महानता और शक्ति को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: اسمان
in_pashto.long_meaning: اسمان: دې آسمان او دې سقف نوم. دا نام د الله تعالي کښې د آسمان او ځمکې جوړولو په نوم کې رولېږي. دا نام په کورني اړخ کښې د آسمان او د الله تعالي کښې د قدرتې څرک په نظر کې نیسي. دا نام په دېرشمانو مسلمانانو کښې د آسمان او د الله تعالي کښې د قدرتې څرک په نظر کې نیسي.

in_english.name: Asman
in_english.meaning: meaning the sky or the vault of heaven
in_english.long_meaning: Asman: a name of Arabic origin, referring to the celestial architecture, and considered one of the beautiful names of Allah in the Quran. Meaning the great sky, Asman is used in the Quran to describe the creation of Allah for the sky and earth. Asman is a common name in Arabic Islamic culture, used to enhance the belief in Allah and his worship.

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name "Asman" may evoke a sense of cosmic connection and grandeur as it is derived from the Arabic word for ‘sky’ or ‘heaven’. In many Islamic cultures, being named Asman may signify an appreciation for natural beauty, celestial phenomena or the vastness of the universe. It may also suggest a deep-rooted respect for astronomical traditions and the teachings of the Islamic faith that emphasizes the importance of observing and understanding the wonders of the heavens.
data.spiritual_significance: For individuals bearing the Islamic name "Asman", the spiritual significance can be profound as it represents a connection to the divine realm. In Islamic tradition, the often-depicted blue dome of the sky or the firmament separating the heavens from the earth, is a constant reminder of the presence of Allah (God) and the other celestial beings, such as angels. Named Asman, one may be daily reminded of the importance of reaching towards the divine through prayer, good deeds and living in accordance to Islamic values. The name can also serve as a reminder of the spiritual journey towards attaining eternal peace in the heavens above.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Asman in Arabic means "heaven" or "sky." It symbolizes the divine realm, the dwelling place of God and the angels, and the source of blessings and guidance for humanity. It is a constant reminder of the eternal and infinite nature of the divine and the importance of striving to connect with the divine in our daily lives.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Asman was the name of the third caliph of the Rashidun Caliphate, Umar ibn Al-Khattab's successor. He ruled from 634 to 644 CE. Asman is remembered for expanding the Islamic empire to include Egypt, Syria, and Iraq, and for suppressing rebellions in Egypt and Syria.
Asman was also a Arabic term for 'sky' in early Islamic literature. It was used in poetry and prose to describe the divine realm where angels resided and God's throne was located.
